questions.name: Most recent seven charge dates · oldest → newest
questions.description: One light for each of the latest seven distinct eligible charge due dates before today; gaps in the calendar are skipped. All eligible charges on a date are combined. Red if any remains overdue; otherwise orange if any was paid late; otherwise green if all were on time. Fewer than seven dates show fewer lights. Today/future, invalid, zero and default-accounting obligations excluded. Hover for the date’s charge counts and amounts. No activity-date mapping.

stages.native:
WITH chosen AS (SELECT * FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE borrower_id= [[{{borrower_id}} --]] '__select_borrower__'
), days AS (SELECT DISTINCT h.due_date
 FROM chosen c JOIN public.reporting_charge_payment_health_v1 h USING(borrower_id)
 WHERE h.history_eligible ORDER BY h.due_date DESC LIMIT 7), daily AS (
 SELECT h.due_date,count(*)::integer charges,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.is_overdue)::integer overdue,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT h.is_overdue AND h.on_time)::integer on_time,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT h.is_overdue AND NOT h.on_time)::integer paid_late,
 sum(h.principal_due) principal_due,sum(h.interest_due) interest_due,sum(h.remaining_current) remaining
 FROM chosen c JOIN public.reporting_charge_payment_health_v1 h USING(borrower_id)
 JOIN days USING(due_date) WHERE h.history_eligible GROUP BY h.due_date)
 SELECT to_char(days.due_date,'DD Mon YY') AS "Charge day",1 AS "Light",1 AS "Size",
 CASE WHEN d.overdue>0 THEN 'Overdue'
 WHEN d.paid_late>0 THEN 'Paid late' ELSE 'Paid on time' END AS "Status",
 days.due_date AS "Charge date",coalesce(d.charges,0) AS "Charges",
 coalesce(d.on_time,0) AS "Paid on time",coalesce(d.paid_late,0) AS "Paid late",coalesce(d.overdue,0) AS "Overdue charges",
 coalesce(d.principal_due,0) AS "Principal due ฿",coalesce(d.interest_due,0) AS "Interest due ฿",
 coalesce(d.remaining,0) AS "Remaining ฿"
 FROM days JOIN daily d USING(due_date) ORDER BY days.due_date

questions.name: Total outstanding principal ฿
questions.description: Borrower lifetime/current loan groups; ignores activity dates. Active return = lifetime active-loan interest / current outstanding principal. Closed totals use only loans whose current status is Closed, including defaulted closures. Interest is gross signed receipts. Coverage date is the existing constant-daily-interest estimate; when already covered it displays the current reporting date, not a historical crossing date.

stages.native:
WITH chosen AS (SELECT * FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE borrower_id= [[{{borrower_id}} --]] '__select_borrower__'
), totals AS (SELECT b."Total Outstanding Principal" principal,b."Active Loan Interest Earned" interest,b."Projected Interest Coverage Date" coverage,
 z.principal closed_principal,z.interest closed_interest FROM chosen c JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=c.borrower_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(original_principal IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(original_principal) END principal,
 CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(interest_received IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(interest_received) END interest
 FROM public.reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1 l WHERE l.borrower_id=c.borrower_id AND l.loan_status='Closed') z) SELECT principal AS "Total outstanding principal ฿" FROM totals

visualization_settings.text: ### Active loans · lifetime receipts / current principal
### Closed loans · lifetime totals for genuinely closed loans

### Most recent seven charge dates · oldest → newest
One light combines all eligible charges due on that date; calendar gaps are skipped. Red = any still overdue · Orange = none overdue but some paid late · Green = all paid on time. Today/future excluded. Hover for daily counts and amounts.

Lifetime figures ignore activity dates. Interest is gross receipts, before expenses. Active return uses **current outstanding principal**, not original lending. Coverage assumes the current daily interest continues; already covered shows today, not the historical coverage date. Closed return uses original principal from closed loans only.
